t: This is the Mayor Gallery on Bury Street, a commercial art gallery that has promoted modern and contemporary art since 1925. Fred Mayor founded it, and Douglas Cooper, the art historian and collector best known for his Cubist works, was also an owner. Since the early 1970s, under Fred's son James Mayor, it has focused on American artists linked to Pop art, Conceptual art and Abstract expressionism. Names shown here include Roy Lichtenstein, Agnes Martin, Robert Rauschenberg, Cy Twombly and Andy Warhol.
